title: elevation
body:
## elevation

Adds a point scalar array named Elevation: each point is projected onto the line from lowPoint to highPoint and the position along that line is mapped linearly onto range, clamped at both ends. Use it to colour by height or depth along any direction, or as a synthetic field for testing. Schemaxis assigns its defaults (z from -1 to 1 mapped to 0 to 1), so set the points to your data's extent.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Points beyond either end point all receive the end value, so a line shorter than the data flattens the field outside it.

Native constructor: `Elevation`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lowPoint` | This property defines low end of the direction vector (small scalar values). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,-1]` | `[0,0,-1]` |
| `highPoint` | This property defines the high end of the direction vector (large scalar values). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,1]` | `[0,0,1]` |
| `range` | This property determines the range into which scalars will be mapped. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2}` | `[0,1]` | `[0,1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "elevation",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
